headline.text: L1 S3 metal detector *failed to reject* pieces damaged by conveyor collision — X-ray caught them, 7 pallets inspected and cleared.

summary: Three active concerns: L1 S3 metal detector failed to reject product after equipment collision (X-ray caught, pallets cleared); L2 panning used quarantined pallet R237581 after mislabel, line under level 2 clean; L1 S2 MT1 stirrer arm sheered and bent during drain, metal fragments not confirmed.

holds.title: 7 pallets Item 30809 held after metal-in-product event
holds.summary: Cross conveyor struck Z conveyor damaging pieces; metal detector did not reject, X-ray did — 7 pallets isolated, 5 pouches/level inspected by QC, all negative, released 11:26.
holds.status: Resolved — all 7 pallets inspected with negative results, released back to production.

food_safety.title: S3 metal detector failed to reject damaged product
food_safety.summary: Cross conveyor collision with Z conveyor created metal-contaminated pieces; metal detector did not reject, X-ray did — 7 pallets held and inspected (all clear), Z conveyor replaced, line cleared 08:59.
food_safety.status: Resolved — damaged conveyor replaced, line clearance complete, pallets released; metal detector performance under review.

food_safety.title: S2 MT1 stirrer arm sheered off and bent during drain
food_safety.summary: Sweep arm found sheered at top and bent into V-shape when emptying MT1; no grinding sounds noted, may have been bent previously — filter inspection showed only common iron rings.
food_safety.status: Open — MT1 disassembled for inspection, glycol drained; ATP and allergen tests failed, full clean in progress.

food_safety.title: ML4 TG3 metal detector faulting and rejecting product
food_safety.summary: Metal detector on TG3 faulted repeatedly 20:41–22:44, kicking off significant product; test cards passing intermittently, belt staying open after reject cycles.
food_safety.status: Open — maintenance troubleshooting; producing at reduced speed, monitoring reject rate.

quality.title: ML2 weight rejections at final checkweigher
quality.summary: Elevated rejects at final weight check 17:02; filler adjusted from target to 60g to reduce downstream rejections and prevent accumulation.
quality.status: Resolved — filler weight adjusted, rejections reduced, monitoring for stability.

quality.title: ML3 multiple double and open pieces at packaging
quality.summary: Production and QA detecting elevated doubles and open packages 05:37; line paused for maintenance adjustment to flow-wrap sealing parameters.
quality.status: Open — maintenance adjusting sealing; team checking initial boxes for affected units.

sanitation.title: S2 MT1 failed ATP and allergen tests after stirrer failure
sanitation.summary: ATP and allergen swabs failed on MT1 following discovery of bent/sheered stirrer arm; unit disassembled for deep clean and inspection.
sanitation.status: Open — full disassembly and re-clean in progress, awaiting retest.

allergen.title: Quarantined pallet R237581 (10140) used in panning
allergen.summary: Pallet R237581 (quarantined) physically mixed with R237578 (released); 3rd shift panned quarantined pallet before discovery — active pallet placed on hold, level 2 clean initiated on panning area.
allergen.status: Open — panned material from quarantined pallet on hold pending QA disposition; level 2 clean underway, open sugar/salt discarded.

opportunities.text: Consider adding metal detector test-card verification to S3 startup checklist — today's conveyor collision event passed X-ray but not MD, suggesting sensitivity drift worth catching earlier.
Consider scheduled inspection interval for MT stirrer arms on S2 — today's bent arm showed no audible warning and may have been damaged over time.
Review warehouse pull procedures for quarantined pallets — today's panning incident (R237581 mixed with R237578) suggests visual hold-status marking may need reinforcement at L2.
